description: MUTATES Sendbird data: sends a message into a channel as a user (MESG) or as an admin (ADMM). File/multipart messages are not supported. Platform API: POST /{channel_type}/{channel_url}/messages.

channel_type.description: Channel type: group_channels (member-based) or open_channels (public, participant-based).

custom_type.description: Custom type tag for the message.

data.description: Additional structured data as a string (often JSON).

is_silent.description: If true, does not update channel's last message / unread counts.

mention_type.description: Mention scope: specific users or the whole channel.

message_type.description: MESG (user text, default) or ADMM (admin message, no sender).

send_push.description: Whether to send push notifications. Default true.

user_id.description: Sender user id. REQUIRED when message_type is MESG.

name: sendbird_send_message
title: Send a message
